proof_summary: Counting pairs divisible by each power of \(p\) and applying Legendre’s factorial-valuation formula gives \(v_p(a(N))=\sum_{i\ge1}\big(\lfloor N/p^i\rfloor^2-\sum_{r\le N}r\lfloor N/(rp^i)\rfloor\big)\), with divisibility of the denominator following from \(\sum_r r\lfloor M/r\rfloor\le M^2\). For \(N=np+k\) with \(k<p\), division by \(p\) always gives \(n\), so all these terms agree with those for \(np\); the newly added indices in the inner sums contribute zero.
